question: Which team won Super Bowl LX (played in February 2026), and what was the score?
answer: The Seattle Seahawks won Super Bowl LX, beating the New England Patriots 29-13 on Feb. 8, 2026. [1] Seattle outscored New England 17-13 in the fourth quarter after leading 12-0 through three quarters. [1] NFL.com's Super Bowl page lists the game as a Seahawks win over the Patriots and names Kenneth Walker III the Super Bowl MVP. [2]
